title: Choose and measure the evidence source and join key that give a hand-closed ticket a real start, end and cost
summary: Measured 238 hand closures (W40-W41); chose declared > tool_activity > unknown with a session_id plus sequential-window claim; schema delta and owner decision recorded.

title: Record real start, end and provenance for hand closures, or null instead of 0
summary: hand_closure_time resolves declared > tool_activity > unknown; runs and events carry session_id and duration_source; unknown is a null duration.

title: Attribute the closing session's tool rows to a hand closure's cost without claiming a row twice
summary: Hand closures carry a session_window cost total (count and cost proxy) on the final event, claimed once per row.

title: Retro reports hand closures by duration provenance, keeping derived durations out of the headline average
summary: Provenance-aware retro: derived beside measured with n, unknown counted not averaged, hand-closed coverage line, changed-meaning note once at the top.
